_note: E103 T3 (was T7): Spanish translations of the InjecForks injection blocks, written by hand (Claude, reviewed by A1). Informal tu, matching the frame's 'te di'. Identifiers, IDs, file names, paths, email addresses, URLs, tool names and quoted strings are kept verbatim. 'frame' holds the fixed template lines per arm; 'goals' maps each of the 75 goal strings parsed from the blocks (e103_brittleness.py) to its translation; a trailing '.' variant of a goal gets the same translation with the same trailing '.'.
